item.elsewhere.lore_survey_fragment.lore: A torn corner of the royal surveyors' chart.
Three of these, joined, make a Royal Survey Map.
item.elsewhere.lore_royal_survey_map.lor: Three joined fragments of the surveyors' chart.
Use it in the Overworld to unfold it.
It points to the nearest Castle Aldermark.
Oathstrength: a sworn knight fights on past wounds that would drop a common soldier.
message.elsewhere.lore_map_no_castle: The lines wander off the edge of what the surveyors knew. No castle found within range.
message.elsewhere.lore_map_wrong_dimensi: The chart only makes sense in the Overworld.
message.elsewhere.lore_map_resolved: The lines resolve. A castle stands where the red X is.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_done: The sergeant nods. "You have the King's word already, traveller."
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_1: <Sergeant> The King's word, traveller. Read it at your leisure, and keep to the road.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_2: <Sergeant> A copy of the Proclamation. Every traveller is owed one, whether they want it or not.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_3: <Sergeant> Take this. If anyone asks, you did not get it from me.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_4: <Sergeant> By order of the Crown. Mind the ink, it is still drying.

item.elsewhere.azmar_well_stone.lore1: A carved stone from a caravan's well-marker.
item.elsewhere.azmar_well_stone.lore2: Where one stands, there is water, and a road.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_hrafnholt: <Hird-Sergeant> The Jarl's oath, stranger. Read it by a fire, and keep your axe in its loop.
<Hird-Sergeant> Take it. The ravens saw you coming, so you may as well know what you are walking into.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_azmar_1: <Caravan-Master> The Sultana's ledger, traveller. It is longer than it looks, and so is the road.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_azmar_2: <Caravan-Master> Water first, then words. The Well-Ledger is yours; the well-stone is for the way.
message.elsewhere.lore_courier_mirewick_: <Reeve> Notice of the Council, citizen. The terms are in order and the fee is waived. Today.
<Reeve> Please keep to the quay. A copy of the Notice for your records.
advancement.elsewhere.whispers.border_hi: Come near a kingdom's border marker: a tower-flag, a raven post, an obelisk or a lantern.
